title: Conversations: code maintenance for the deinterlacing method
description:
Following some comments after this feature was first introduced,
some code cleaning or isolation in new functions is necessary to
be more consistent with the general coding conventions of this
software.

I think this looks good. It would be useful (perhaps in a later MR) to constify the `packet_info *` parameter in a number of the `find_conversation` functions - especially because a number of the reassembly related functions take a `const packet_info *` and the current API makes it difficult to look up a conversation as part of fragment functions.
